flows:
Navigate to https://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp#main then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
If a consent dialog is visible, @v16:"dismiss it with the keyboard".
Before starting the swatch interaction, re-open the color picker in the same tab by navigating to https://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp and then to https://www.w3schools.com/colors/colors_picker.asp#main.
This restores the bookmarked starting point after consent.
Press Tab three times from that starting point.
The first two stops are Previous and Next, then the third is the leftmost dark blue hexagon in the top row.
Press Enter once on that swatch and verify the selected color reads #003366.

summary:
Reopened the W3Schools color picker at its main section as requested.
A visible consent prompt was dismissed using the keyboard.
Used Tab to move through Previous, Next, and the leftmost dark-blue swatch in the top row, then activated that swatch with Enter.
The color picker finished with #003366 selected.
